limitations: PARTIAL AUDIT: Only a hand-verified subset of 205 Stripe receipt matches (198 message bodies returned) was transferred into the files; historical totals are minimums and should not be interpreted as full spend.
Only one connected Gmail mailbox was accessible; no other company inboxes or payment accounts verified.
Receipts go back at least to 2025-12-16 but historical mailbox coverage across all search terms is not proven.
Most invoice PDF attachments were not individually opened; missing details such as tax, billing dates and invoice IDs were left null.
Retry/failed-payment emails can represent the same attempted charge multiple times.
A Midjourney credit note was applied to account balance; cash refund has not been verified, so it is excluded from cash refund totals.
No bank/card statements were reconciled; account or plan status not established from old receipts.
Not all non-Stripe charges, refunds, and billing emails have been reconciled.
